name: Achiltibuie
method: tidetimes.org.uk Tanera Mor vs its own Ullapool (UKHO-derived), applied to our gauge-fitted Ullapool: median time difference, least-squares height fit
note: tidetimes' Tanera Mor, in the Summer Isles off Achiltibuie. Height = offset + scale * Ullapool. tidetimes' Tanera Mor is Ullapool moved 5 min (HW) and 10 min (LW) to the minute, so times are as good as Ullapool's. One height map for HW and LW: separate ones fitted ~0.03 m better but don't cross inside the range, so the curve would miss the turns. Heights follow tidetimes, Ullapool's Z0 is set to UKHO's level. Kayak-grade, not for navigation.
calibrated_from: tidetimes.org.uk Achiltibuie vs Ullapool, 2025-10-01 to 2026-12-01 (every 3 day(s), 556 events) via tools/calibrate-shift.ts
